name: Authyo OTP for Met Form
author: Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
Authyo OTP for MetForm allows you to verify phone numbers and email addresses in your MetForm forms using One-Time Passwords (OTP).
Supports multiple channels including SMS, WhatsApp, Voice Call, and Email.

Important Note: OTP verification requires valid Authyo API credentials and sufficient wallet balance. When unavailable, form submissions will proceed without OTP verification to prevent lead loss.

Disclaimer: This plugin is an independent third-party integration for MetForm. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially supported by MetForm.

Features

  • Multi-Channel Verification: Deliver OTPs via SMS, WhatsApp, Voice Call, or Email.
  • Seamless MetForm Integration: Automatically integrates with native Authyo widgets in MetForm.
  • Visitor Choice: Optionally allow visitors to choose their preferred verification method.
  • Failsafe Behavior: If the Authyo API cannot deliver OTP messages due to insufficient balance, the plugin may automatically allow form submission without OTP verification.
  • Customizable Security: Configure OTP length, expiry time, and resend cooldowns.

Video Tutorial

Video Tutorial How to Use Authyo OTP for MetForm

Company Information

This plugin is developed and maintained by Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt. Ltd.

Authyo is a service owned and operated by Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt. Ltd. and is used by this plugin solely for one-time password (OTP) generation and verification. Details about data usage and applicable privacy and terms policies are provided in the section above.

External Services

This plugin utilizes the Authyo API (https://app.authyo.io) to send and verify One-Time Passwords (OTP).

  • Service Name: Authyo
  • Service URL: https://authyo.io
  • Data Sent: Phone numbers and email addresses entered into the OTP verification forms are sent to Authyo servers to dispatch verification codes.
  • Privacy Policy: Please refer to the Authyo Privacy Policy for details on how this data is handled.
  • Terms of Service: Authyo Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/authyo-otp-for-met-form directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Authyo OTP settings page to configure your API keys and defaults.
sections.faq:
Does this require MetForm?

Yes, this plugin is an addon for MetForm which should be installed and active.

Do I need an Authyo account?

Yes, you need an account at Authyo.io to obtain your API credentials (App ID, Client ID, Client Secret).

Is user data stored locally?

No user-specific data (such as phone numbers, email addresses, or OTP codes) is stored permanently in your local WordPress database. Temporary session data is managed via WordPress transients.
